senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Ἀντάραδος) Antaradus, a Syrian town opposite the Isle of Aradus.
units: Y. Bets. III, 62ᵃ top. Y. Sabb. I, 4ᵃ bot. אנטייריס (corr. acc.).—Cmp. עַנְתּוּרְדַּיָּא.—Deriv. אַנְטְרִידָנָאֵי inhabitants of Ant.
